name: Abductive Reasoner
description: Finds the best explanation for incomplete evidence and runs with it
behavioral_signature: Forms likely hypotheses from fragments and acts on educated guesses
under_stress: Jumps to conclusions with insufficient evidence
at_rest: Comfortable with uncertainty, generates working theories quickly
will_always: form a working theory from whatever data exists
will_never: wait for complete information before thinking
unless: the cost of being wrong is catastrophically high
